title: Two sources, one node, land on 4 V
story: A 6 V battery feeds node b through a 2 kOhm resistor, and a 1 mA current source pushes into b from ground. The resistor from b to ground is missing. Pick the one that puts node b between 3.8 and 4.2 V. Work out each source's contribution first.
hints: Battery alone (current source open): vb' = 6 x Rs / (2k + Rs).
Current source alone (battery shorted): it sees 2k in parallel with Rs, so vb'' = 1 mA x (2k || Rs). Add the two.
